title: .DS_Store files in Documents
whyItMatters: Finder writes .DS_Store files into folders you opened; they record folder view settings and reveal which folders were browsed.
source: SWGDE technical notes on macOS artifacts (13-F-002) list .DS_Store as a Finder activity artifact
notes: Narrow replacement for a whole-home walk, which hit maxEntries before finding anything (the walker counts every visited entry). Documents is TCC-protected without Full Disk Access.

steps: In the Finder choose Go > Go to Folder and open the folder named in the plan.
Select the .DS_Store files and move them to the Trash.
Empty the Trash before the Mac changes hands.
cleanup.risk: Finder writes a new .DS_Store file as soon as someone opens the folder again, so this is a small last-minute step.
cleanup.source: Apple Support, Delete files and folders on Mac: https://support.apple.com/guide/mac-help/delete-files-and-folders-on-mac-mchlp1093/mac
